deleting and re-importing the recipient certificate completely restarting Thunderbird after importing it manually typing the recipient address in lowercase without using autocomplete checking the complete CA certificate chain temporarily disabling OCSP

nsIMsgComposeSecure.beginCryptoEncapsulation

title: New Thunderbird add-on: Easy Table Editor by Cardella — feedback welcome
creator: henrique.cardella
content:
Hello Thunderbird community,

I have released Easy Table Editor by Cardella, a free and open-source extension created to make HTML table editing easier inside Thunderbird's message composer.

The extension adds a table editor directly beside the message formatting controls and includes:

• Mouse-drag selection of multiple cells • Simultaneous formatting of selected cells • Column and row resizing with the mouse • Row and column insertion or removal • Cell merging and splitting • Header-cell conversion • Text, background, border and alignment controls • Clean, modern table templates • The ability to save the current table as a reusable model • Interface localization in ten languages

The extension works locally. It does not use analytics, tracking, external servers or remote resources. Saved table models remain in Thunderbird's local storage.

Thunderbird Add-ons page: https://addons.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/addon/easy-table-editor-by-cardella/

Compatibility: Thunderbird 151 or newer.

This is a personal and independent project. I would appreciate feedback from the community, especially about usability, compatibility and features that would make HTML table editing better.

Thank you! Henrique Cardella

title: A recently downloaded e-mail is no longer visible in the inbox although a search for the sender finds the e-mail and says that it is in the inbox.
creator: gary_at_home
content:
As background, I recently migrated to Thunderbird and imported a very large number of e-mails. The issue, however, is in regard to a new e-mail that was downloaded yesterday.

The new e-mail was downloaded in a normal fashion, but when I went to look for the e-mail in the Inbox, it was no longer visible in the (although I had not moved it or deleted it).

Running a search on the sender's name finds the e-mail. It is in a thread of 6 or 7 e-mails. The search shows the e-mail is located in the Inbox, however a sort by sender name in the Inbox does not reveal the e-mail.

In the search result, I starred the e-mail (it is the only starred e-mail in my e-mail database), but a search of all my e-mail folders shows no starred e-mails at all.

I also went through all my folders and moved all e-mails into the "read" status, then found the lost e-mail using the search function and marked it as unread.

The Inbox folder shows that I have one unread e-mail in the folder, however when I filter for unread e-mails, the results are zero.
